per_fact.description: Bhiwandi (FC-WEST-01) 24-hour Assured dispatch SLA attainment is 86.2% (vs the 96.5% contractual guarantee).
Bhiwandi backlog of 41,800 staged cages awaiting linehaul dispatch (as of 15:00Z).
Total unmitigated carrier/rebate/voucher exposure of $313,330.
430 high-value duplicate UPI holds totalling $61,250 still need manual settlement reconciliation.
Immediate containment spend of $24,200 (BlueDart standby fleet + night-shift loader overtime) is the ask.
The cage backlog must be cleared before 23:59Z tonight to avoid the carrier surcharges.
Remaining duplicate UPI holds must be cleared before the 04:00Z T+1 bank settlement batch.
Late Dispatch Penalty waivers only for the 312 Gate-3-verified sellers (no blanket waiver).
Diwali Sale Day 3 closed at $38.4M daily GMV.
Cross-belt diverter jams on Sorter Lane 4 (oversized appliances) dropped sorter availability to 81.4%.
A 3-second client timeout against 4.8-second PSP callbacks (p99 420ms -> 4,850ms) caused the pending/duplicate holds.
$77,330 in direct carrier surcharges if the backlog is not cleared.
$142,000 Week-46 rebate forfeiture risk if Western Zone on-time-tender falls below 92.0%.
$94,000 potential Assured late-delivery buyer credits if backlog age crosses 16 hours.
Approve the $14,400 BlueDart standby fleet (18 trailers at Gate 7).
Audit the 47 phantom-manifest (zero-inventory) sellers instead of waiving their penalty.
Gross exposure mitigation ratio of 12.9x for the containment spend.
Ananya Deshmukh (VP Fulfillment) proposes and owns the containment decisions.
AetherSonic commits an $18.0M Year-1 inventory allocation (projected Year-1 GMV $18M).
Referral commission reduced from 11.5% to 9.75% on verified MAP-compliant brand-direct orders.
FBO-Assured 1-Day Prime fee locked at a flat $3.65/unit for items <=1.2kg.
AetherSonic commits a $480,000/yr minimum Co-Op (Sponsored Search & Homepage Hero) budget.
The commission concession is worth ~$315k/yr to AetherSonic at $18M GMV.
Go-live on February 15 (Q1 FY2027) across the Top 18 Metro Regions.
Termination trigger: >2% grey-market MAP leakage over a 14-day window gives AetherSonic a 30-day exclusivity unwind right.
AetherSonic requests T+3 settlement (vs standard T+7), which needs Director approval and zero KYC/TIN mismatches.
Standard Consumer Electronics referral commission is 11.5%.
The $3.65 FBO tier is below the standard $4.40 schedule (a $0.75/unit subsidy).
Guaranteed 4.8x ROAS floor on the Co-Op spend.
The FBO rate requires AetherSonic to pre-position 65% of safety stock across the 4 regional hubs.
45-day early launch exclusivity on the StudioPulse X2 flagship.
Overbox damage shield worth ~$954,000 annualized GMV retention (crush returns 7.4% -> 2.1%).
UN38.3 certifications: 26 of 28 SKUs uploaded, 2 pending lab sign-off.
All 28 UPCs/EANs enrolled into Brand Registry Lock by January 10, 2027.
T+3 settlement backed by a $250,000 rolling return reserve for 90 days post-launch.
Siddharth Rao (NovaMart VP Category Partnerships) leads the partnership for NovaMart.
The thermal event caused zero human injuries / zero personnel exposure.
Seller packed undeclared 26,800mAh / 99.16Wh cells inside shells stamped 10,000mAh / 37Wh to evade UN38.3 declarations.
15 SKUs permanently delisted and 4 seller accounts terminated for falsified safety documents / undeclared >100Wh cells.
Fleet audit: 334 of 412 SKUs (81.1%) verified compliant.
548 recalled units remain unreturned.
Commitment to close all open recall returns by November 15, 2026.
FLIR handheld imaging on the remaining 10 Tier-2 spokes by November 30, 2026.
$184,000 terminated-seller escrow frozen to backstop recall refunds and statutory liability.
63 of 412 SKUs (15.3%) suspended pending valid test summary / label match.
Recall notices sent to 1,420 customers who bought the falsified SKUs.
Recall response/return completion at 61.4% as of September 30.
$58,220 cumulative buyer refund reserve booked.
The seller uploaded a forged BIS IS 16046 certificate at onboarding.
Forged-certificate evidence referred to the Bureau of Market Surveillance and Economic Offences Wing.
$42,000 approved capex for the remaining FLIR rollout.
$12,400 containment remediation cost (absorbed in Q3 Safety OpEx).
Hard TMS API block keeps >37Wh spare batteries / UN3480 packs off passenger air manifests.
No UN3480 label or short-circuit separators; transit vibration fractured a nickel tab, initiating thermal runaway.
68.2% of ESCROW_HOLD_409 holds (146 of 214) were false-positive name-normalization mismatches.
68 genuine compliance-gap holds with $1.41M exposure.
Median manual review time slipped to 83.5 hours.
Section 14.3 contractual review SLA of 48 business hours.
194 raw sensitive PII artifacts were logged before the regex gate (0 after).
$286,000 attempted synthetic GMV from a 14-account shell ring blocked before settlement.
$4.82M of seller funds held under ESCROW_HOLD_409 during the audit period.
Projected Section 14.3 arbitration legal & interest exposure ~$147,500/quarter (range $115,000-$180,000).
1,850 sellers audited.
214 sellers (11.6%) triggered ESCROW_HOLD_409 holds.
146 false-positive hold accounts.
Three Tier-1 sellers issued Section 14.3 arbitration pre-notices over wrongful 96-hour holds.
False positives come from legal-suffix / name string-normalization mismatches (e.g. LLC vs Pvt Ltd).
19 accounts routed payouts to third-party aggregator IBANs outside their jurisdiction.
Legal-suffix normalizer + micro-deposit name check to cut false-positive 409 holds by 65%.
Dedicated 12-hour SLA fast lane for false-positive holds on clean Platinum sellers.
Zero-PII ticket vault: regex masking at ingestion + encrypted KMS tax-document vault.
Names an accountable function from the source: Treasury Operations or Information Security.
